title: DZS-160 / DZS-210 / DZS-260 - Deesys square busbar-through ZCT, 200 mA / 100 mV
description: Deesys DZS square (busbar-through) zero-phase sequence current transformer for earth-leakage detection on busbar systems where a round window will not fit. Voltage-output type at 200 mA / 100 mV, in three window sizes from 30 × 160 mm to 30 × 260 mm covering 400 A to 600 A.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Square busbar-through window for flat busbar runs
High magnetivity core giving high linearity and safety characteristics
ABS non-flammable casing with terminal cover
Type approved by inspection agency for fire

rows: DZS-160 : rated 400 A, window 30 × 160 mm, 2.8 kg
DZS-210 : rated 500 A, window 30 × 210 mm, 3.5 kg
DZS-260 : rated 600 A, window 30 × 260 mm, 3.8 kg
Zero phase current ratio : 200 mA / 100 mV (75–125 mV at 2 kΩ)
Withstand voltage : AC 2000 V for 1 min (between secondary coil and base)
Insulation resistance : more than 1000 MΩ at DC 500 V (between coil and base)
